newsitem.title: FINLAND: Metra to gain FIM 44 mln on hotel sale.
newsitem.headline: Metra to gain FIM 44 mln on hotel sale.

text.p: Finnish diversified engineering group Metra Oy will gain about 44 billion markka on the sale of Hotel Strand Inter-Continental, Metra Executive Vice President Ole Johansson told a news conference on Monday.
"We're selling the real estate for 204 million markka and its balance sheet value is 160 million markka," Johansson said, adding Metra would book the gain as a one-off item this year.
Metra earler said in a statement it was selling the Helsinki hotel to a real estate company to be establised and in which it would have a 19 percent stake.
The other partners in the new real estate company are state-owned beverage, hotel and restaurant group Alko-Yhtiot with 41 percent and national carrier Finnair Oy with 40 percent, Metra said.
The new company would also take over Finnair's Hotel Inter-Continental property and have a share capital of 400 million markka, with Metra planning to invest 76 million.
"The real estate company will lease both hotel properties to Nordic-Hotel Oy, a hotel and restaurant management company," Metra said.
